name: Ice
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign power in the creation and control of ice and frost, as seen in Job's questioning of its origin from the 'womb' of heaven (Job 38:29). Ice is portrayed both as a natural phenomenon that covers the earth (Job 6:16) and as a demonstration of God's might, casting forth ice like morsels before whom none can stand (Psalms 147:17). Additionally, Proverbs likens the refreshing and timely nature of a faithful messenger to the coldness of snow during harvest, emphasizing the soul-renewing qualities associated with ice and cold.
